items.raw_excerpt: Former St John paramedics now working in other parts of the organisation are being asked to jump back into ambulances to meet "exceptional" demand.

items.raw_excerpt: The Netherlands’ shift to electric cars is being driven overwhelmingly by its wealthiest households, while lower earners buy up the country’s oldest and most polluting vehicles, new figures from national statistics office CBS show. Of the roughly 259,000 fully electric cars and plug-in hybrids bought or changed hands in 2025, the highest-earning 10% of households took almost 75,000 – more than a quarter of the total. Add the next bracket down and the top fifth of earners account for close...
items.summary_en: In the Netherlands, the richest ten percent of households bought nearly 75,000 electric cars in 2025. That is more than a quarter of all electric cars sold. Lower earners are buying older, more polluting petrol cars instead.

items.summary_ko: 조류독감이 뉴질랜드의 가금류 산업에 계속 위협을 가하고 있습니다. 계단 생산자 연합은 자유방목 닭들이 향후 몇 달 동안 봉쇄를 오갈 가능성이 있다고 밝혔습니다. 이번 조치는 해당 지역에서 조류독감 사례가 계속 발생함에 따라 이루어지고 있습니다.
items.title_en: Free-range hens likely to go in and out of lockdown as bird flu cases continue to emerge
items.title_ko: 조류독감 확산으로 자유방목 닭들이 봉쇄를 오갈 가능성
